title: DED, the Designer Definition Language, version 0.2
description: A DED definition in its YAML or JSON form: the envelope of DED section 2, and the designer type's own content beside it. A designer type's file schema refines $defs/Definition with an allOf; this schema checks the envelope only. The XML and Markdown forms are checked after reading their envelope into this form (DED section 6). The $id is the one DED 0.1 gave the schema: 0.2 keeps every 0.1 definition valid.

Definition.description: One document a user created of a designer type (DED section 3).

ded.description: The version of DED the definition is written in (DED section 2).

designer.description: The origin of the designer type the definition was made with, `<vendor>/<type>` (DESL section 3.2).
